title: Weeknote #2016
summary: St Jude, GTA, and lots of other links.
content:
We just passed $2000 on the St Jude Fundraiser and it’s not even September yet. Donate here.

On Ruminate this week I spoke about the worst snack I've ever tried for the show. Truly awful.

This Mastodon tool to see which servers the people I follow are on as well as where my followers are is interesting and highlights again that mastodon.social is just too large.

FontFridge is an "enhanced Google Fonts collection" with better filtering based on the features of the fonts (variable axes, weight, etc) and it also has a favourites features.

This article about favicons is excellent and allowed me to reduce the amount of non-essential icons I'm generating on Favicons to Go.

There's another open source app to replace Logitech Options - OpenLogi. I haven't tried it but it's good to have options.

Terence Eden's ActivityBot has come a long way since I last looked at it. Worth keeping bookmarked for any bots I want to make.

GoldenPad is an iOS and MacOS port of Goldeneye 64. Neat.

Dayna has made a printable zine holder template which is very cool. Will be trying this soon.

Lego have some amazing new Mario sets with actual minifigures. via Marty

I adored The Social Network but I don't have it in me to watch The Social Reckoning no matter how good it looks.

Queen Budapest can be injected right into my veins though.

GTAVI looks exactly like I expected, it’s GTA. Definitely gunna buy it.
